```gherkin
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Controller detects and receives alarms from GUI
    Given the GUI sends an alarm to the controller
    When the controller receives the alarm
    Then the controller detects the alarm

  Scenario: Controller commands hardware PCB buzzer
    Given the controller is connected to the hardware PCB buzzer
    When the controller commands the buzzer to sound
    Then the buzzer sounds

  Scenario: GUI/Controller enumerates alarm codes and assigns priorities
    Given the controller has a list of alarm codes and priorities
    When the GUI requests the list of alarm codes and priorities
    Then the GUI displays the list of alarm codes and priorities

  Scenario: GUI displays highest priority alarm on main screen
    Given the controller has a list of active alarms with different priorities
    When the GUI displays the main screen
    Then the GUI displays the highest priority alarm on the main screen

  Scenario: GUI displays list of active alarms on button press
    Given the controller has a list of active alarms
    When the user presses the button to view active alarms
    Then the GUI displays the list of active alarms

  Scenario: GUI displays alarm on main screen legible at distance of 1 meter
    Given the GUI displays an alarm on the main screen
    When the user views the main screen from a distance of 1 meter
    Then the alarm is legible

  Scenario: High severity alarms are indicated with red color and flashing frequency of 2Hz with 50% duty cycle
    Given the controller has a high severity alarm
    When the GUI displays the alarm
    Then the alarm is displayed with a red color and a flashing frequency of 2Hz with a 50% duty cycle

  Scenario: Low severity alarms are indicated with yellow color which is constantly on
    Given the controller has a low severity alarm
    When the GUI displays the alarm
    Then the alarm is displayed with a yellow color which is constantly on

  Scenario Outline: GUI displays alarm on main screen with different alarm codes and priorities
    Given the controller has a list of alarm codes and priorities
    When the GUI displays the main screen with the alarm code <alarm_code> and priority <priority>
    Then the GUI displays the alarm on the main screen with the alarm code <alarm_code> and priority <priority>

    Examples:
      | alarm_code | priority |
      | HIGH       | 1        |
      | MEDIUM     | 2        |
      | LOW        | 3        |

  Scenario Outline: GUI displays list of active alarms with different alarm codes and priorities
    Given the controller has a list of active alarms with alarm codes <alarm_code> and priorities <priority>
    When the user presses the button to view active alarms
    Then the GUI displays the list of active alarms with alarm codes <alarm_code> and priorities <priority>

    Examples:
      | alarm_code | priority |
      | HIGH       | 1        |
      | MEDIUM     | 2        |
      | LOW        | 3        |
```
